purpose.zh: 在侧撑中练臀中肌主动开腿
purpose.en: Train the side glutes to lift the leg while holding a side plank.

text.zh: 前臂侧撑，髋抬起成一条直线
text.en: Prop on your forearm and lift your hips into one straight line

text.zh: 上方腿伸直抬起，脚尖朝前不外转
text.en: Lift the straight top leg with the toes pointing forward.

text.zh: 手肘在肩正下方，慢抬慢放
text.en: Keep your elbow under your shoulder and lift and lower slowly.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时改为屈膝侧撑或减少次数，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If your shoulder hurts, bend your knees or do fewer reps, and stop if the pain continues.
